title: Newspaper names a Frank Beverage household on Green Street and visitor Orra Roney
description: The August 1, 1911 Courier-Gazette reports that Mrs. Orra Roney and daughter Jeanette of Stonington were visiting Mr. and Mrs. Frank Beverage on Green Street. This provides a named household association, but the exact town, the couple's identities and any relationship to a North Haven Frank remain to be checked. A later Thomaston cemetery plot listing includes an Orra S. Roney, which makes the household a useful identification lead, not a proved family relationship.
place: Green Street (town not established in this excerpt)
evidence_status: Contemporary 1911 newspaper record, unidentified Frank household; do not merge with North Haven Frank

title: Thomaston cemetery's Frank Beverage plot card includes a 1939 date
description: A transcribed Thomaston Village Cemetery plot-card table lists a Frank Beverage, Section 8 Lot 76, with a date of February 5, 1939, and multiple named persons in the plot including Orra S. Roney. The table is an index of burial plot information, not independently reviewed death certification: the date must not be silently treated as a verified death date. This 1939-dated cemetery Frank cannot be the same as a Frank who physically signed a North Haven album in 1954 if both sources are accurate.
evidence_status: Derivative transcription of cemetery plot-card; date purpose and identity require original card/certificate

title: Frank Beverage records his age and birth date in North Haven autograph album
description: A transcription of Elizabeth Bean Calderwood Carter's autograph album reports a July 19, 1954 inscription signed Frank Beverage at North Haven, giving birth as January 14, 1861 and age 93. This matches the North Haven Frank profile's existing birth-date source. The physical album entry has not been reexamined, and the name Frank in the 1939 Thomaston plot listing should not be merged with him.
evidence_status: Transcription of dated, purportedly first-person autograph artifact; original page not examined

title: North Haven newspaper reports Frank and May Beverage's 43rd wedding anniversary
description: The October 18, 1930 Courier-Gazette's NORTH HAVEN news section reports that Mr. and Mrs. Frank Beverage celebrated their forty-third wedding anniversary on Wednesday evening, October 15. An independent diary transcription records Frank and May's fiftieth wedding anniversary on October 15, 1937. Taken together, the commemorations strongly support October 15, 1887 as the couple's reported wedding date. Neither is the original marriage return, and it is not yet proved which tree profile represents this Frank or what May's maiden name was.
evidence_status: Independent 1930 contemporary newspaper and 1937 diary support an 1887-10-15 anniversary; original marriage register and exact identities pending
